newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bellcore in US$20 mln Telstra software deal.
newsitem.headline: Bellcore in US$20 mln Telstra software deal.

text.p: Bellcore International, the research arm of the U.S regional Bells, said on Monday it had struck a US$20 million deal with Telstra Corp to develop software for Australia's broadband telcommunications network.
The software could be used to manage existing telecommunications networks and the broadband systems of the future, Bellcore said in a statement.

The confirmation of the deal comes a year after the Australian state-owned telecommunications carrier firm Telstra said it had agreed to collaborate on research into the software necessary to run a broadband network.
Bellcore made its announcement in Singapore at Asia Telecom '97, the four-yearly telcommunications trade fair where 476 of the world's leading telecoms companies from 31 countries are gathered.
